  "clusters": [

      "cluster_id": "E2#1",
      "reason": "refers to the type of cuisine served",
      "attribute": "restaurant_name",
      "evidence": "I have five places. Do you prefer, Italian, [[Chinese]], Mexican or Indian?",
      "mixed": false,
      "placement": "current entity E2"

    {

      "reason": "refers to specific restaurant names",

      "evidence": "There are the Peking Restaurant, which is expensive, the Good Luck Chinese Food Takeaway, which is also expensive, and the [[Lucky Star]], which is cheap.",
      "mixed": false,
      "placement": "current entity E2"
    },
    {
      "cluster_id": "E2#48",
      "reason": "refers to the day of the reservation",
      "attribute": "reservation_time",
      "evidence": "Great! I also need an expensive restaurant in the west that serves Persian for the [[same day]] and party as well please.",
      "mixed": false,
      "placement": "current entity E2"
    },
    {
      "cluster_id": "E2#42",
      "reason": "refers to the reservation of a table",

      "mixed": false,
      "placement": "current entity E2"
    },
    {
      "cluster_id": "E2#11",
      "reason": "refers to the day of the reservation",
      "attribute": "reservation_time",

      "mixed": false,
      "placement": "current entity E2"
    },
    {

      "reason": "refers to the number of people for the reservation",

      "mixed": false,
      "placement": "current entity E2"
    },
    {
      "cluster_id": "E2#20",
      "reason": "refers to specific restaurant names",
      "attribute": "restaurant_name",
      "evidence": "Yes, they had a table available and I went ahead and booked it for you. Your reference number is HXSPEY9N. What else can I do for you? | turn: I'll need a taxi to get me from downing college to [[pizza express]] by 17:45. can you set that up for me?",
      "mixed": false,
      "placement": "current entity E2"
    },
    {
      "cluster_id": "E2#46",
      "reason": "refers to the address of the restaurant",
      "attribute": "restaurant_address",
      "evidence": "I recommend Jinling Noodle Bar. It's located at [[11 Peas Hill City Center]]. Would you like me to book a table for you?",
      "mixed": false,
      "placement": "current entity E2"
    },
    {
      "cluster_id": "E2#40",
      "reason": "refers to specific restaurant names",
      "attribute": "restaurant_name",
      "evidence": "Graffiti is an excellent choice! It's an expensive British restaurant on the west side. Would you like a table there?",
      "mixed": false,
      "placement": "current entity E2"
    },
    {
      "cluster_id": "E2#2",
      "reason": "refers to the address of the restaurant",
      "attribute": "restaurant_address",
      "evidence": "Anatolia is located at [[30 Bridge Street]] City Centre.",
      "mixed": false,
      "placement": "current entity E2"
    },
    {
      "cluster_id": "E2#6",
      "reason": "refers to the phone number of the restaurant",
      "attribute": "restaurant_phone_number",
      "evidence": "The phone number for the Nirala is [[01223 360966]]. Is there anything else I can help you with?",
      "mixed": false,
      "placement": "current entity E2"
    },
    {
      "cluster_id": "E2#7",
      "reason": "refers to the type of restaurant",
      "attribute": "restaurant_name",
      "evidence": "I would like a [[restaurant]] that serves eritrean food and in the expensive price range.",
      "mixed": false,
      "placement": "current entity E2"
    },
    {
      "cluster_id": "E2#9",
      "reason": "refers to the number of people for the reservation",
      "attribute": "restaurant_capacity",
      "evidence": "Yes please for [[six people]] thank you.",
      "mixed": false,
      "placement": "current entity E2"
    },
    {
      "cluster_id": "E2#15",
      "reason": "refers to the general location of the restaurant",
      "attribute": "restaurant_location",
      "evidence": "There are two. Both are expensive. One is in the north and one is in the [[centre]]. Do you have a preference?",
      "mixed": false,
      "placement": "current entity E2"
    },
    {
      "cluster_id": "E2#0",
      "reason": "refers to the general location of the restaurant",
      "attribute": "restaurant_location",
      "evidence": "The restaurant should be in the expensive price range and should be in the [[south]], i do not have a particular food preference.",
      "mixed": false,
      "placement": "current entity E2"
    },
    {
      "cluster_id": "E2#17",
      "reason": "refers to the price range of the restaurant",
      "attribute": "restaurant_price_range",
      "evidence": "There is one African restuarant in the Center. It is named Bedouin, and is [[expensive]]. Their phone number is 01223367660. Would you like me to book for you?",
      "mixed": false,
      "placement": "current entity E2"
    },
    {
      "cluster_id": "E2#29",
      "reason": "refers to the duration of the reservation",
      "attribute": "not_attribute",
      "evidence": "Your booking was successful. Your reference number is R3VOQJMB. The table will be reserved for [[15 minutes]].",
      "mixed": false,
      "placement": "current entity E2"
    },
    {
      "cluster_id": "E2#26",
      "reason": "refers to the name of the college",
      "attribute": "not_attribute",
      "evidence": "I would suggest downing [[college]], would you like the address?",
      "mixed": false,
      "placement": "current entity E2"
    },
    {
      "cluster_id": "E2#10",
      "reason": "refers to the time of the reservation",
      "attribute": "reservation_time",
      "evidence": "I need reservations for 5 people at [[15:15]] on Sunday. I'll need the reference number as well.",
      "mixed": false,
      "placement": "current entity E2"
    },
    {
      "cluster_id": "E2#51",
      "reason": "refers to specific restaurant names",
      "attribute": "restaurant_name",
      "evidence": "How about [[cafe uno]] or don pasquale pizzeria?",
      "mixed": false,
      "placement": "current entity E2"
    }
  ]
}
